items.name: Bleeding
items.text: You take {=effects.0.value|abs} damage at the start of each of your turns, for {=duration.rounds} rounds. A stim ends it early.

items.name: Burning
items.text: You take {=effects.0.value|abs} damage at the start of each of your turns until the fire is put out. You, or anyone next to you, can put it out for 1 AP.
ends_on: extinguish (1 AP, anyone adjacent or self)
items.save_note: a hit's rider (incendiary rounds, a grenade, the flamer) allows no save

items.name: Weakened
items.text: You deal {=effects.0.value|abs}% less damage. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Slowed
items.text: Your Movement is halved. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Silenced
items.text: You can't draw or Evoke Sigils, use Outbursts, pray or make Calls. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round.

items.name: Nausea
items.text: You have {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less on your turn. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Pinned
items.text: You can't move and you have −2 to hit. Lasts until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Stunned
items.text: You lose your next turn, and you can't use reactions until it has passed.

items.name: Dazed
items.text: You have {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less on your next turn.

items.name: Blinded
items.text: You have −4 to hit and can only see the tiles next to you. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round.

items.name: Prone
items.text: You are on the ground. Melee attacks against you have +{=effects.0.value} to hit and ranged attacks against you have −2. Standing up costs 1 AP.

items.name: Left Brain Debuff
items.text: You have {=effects.0.value} on checks with Mind skills, and drawing a glyph or Evoking costs {=effects.1.value} AP more. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Right Brain Debuff
items.text: You have {=effects.0.value} on checks with Expression and Soul skills, and your Soul spells cost {=effects.2.value}% more MP. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Confused
items.text: Each attack you make has a {=effects.0.value}% chance to go at a random target instead: anyone else you could have attacked. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round.

items.name: Fear
items.label: Afraid
items.text: You are Afraid of whoever caused it: you can't move toward them or attack them, and you have −2 to hit anyone else. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Shaken
items.text: You have −2 on Heart saves and on social checks. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds in a fight, or the rest of the scene outside one.

items.name: Hidden
items.text: Enemies can't target you until they spot you. Your first attack from hiding is an Ambush and gets the Ambush damage bonus; after it you are revealed.
items.notes: The Sigil word MASK makes its target Hidden for 2 rounds, or until the target attacks. MASK can't hide a Marked target.

items.name: Marked
items.text: The squad of whoever Marked you gets +{=effects.0.value} to hit you, and you can't become Hidden. It lasts until the fight ends or the Mark is lifted.

items.name: Read
items.text: Whoever put this on you, and their side, see what you mean to do on your next turn (its first action and its target) until that turn ends.
items.source: Classes 3.0 (rev4-primitives.md batch row read): Shadow's Read Intent, the Operative's Analyze, Bonds' aim read

items.name: Judged
items.text: A Chaplain's weapon struck you on its turn: its patron's interventions land on you first. It lasts until your next turn ends.
items.source: Classes 3.0 (chaplain-spec.md rule 9; rules 1.31): how "where the weapon struck" is known

items.name: Braced
items.text: You have set yourself or your weapon in place. The move or weapon that Braced you says what you gain. It ends when you move.

effects.note: bonus defined by the weapon or move that sets it

items.engine_state: unit field (u.braced); applying the id 'braced' gives Emplaced, which has its own entry

items.name: Overwatch
items.text: You are holding AP for one reaction shot at an enemy that moves where you can see it. It ends when you take the shot or when your next turn starts.
items.engine_state: unit field (not a condition the engine applies by id)

items.name: Witnessed
items.text: Your patron is watching you. Your attacks that carry a tag your patron likes get +2 to hit (a kill is not such a tag: for a patron that likes kills, a kill made while Witnessed earns +{=effects.0.value} on your next attack roll, kept after Witnessed ends), and a taboo action costs double Devotion XP. You become Witnessed, if you have Faith 5, when a Hymn of your own patron succeeds or you work a Miracle. It lasts until the fight ends or your patron intervenes.

items.name: Downed
items.text: You are at 0 HP and can't act. At the start of each of your turns you roll a death save: 10 or more on a d20 is a success. Three successes and you stabilise at 1 HP; three failures and you die. Each hit you take while Downed adds a failure. An ally can stabilise you with a stim.
items.engine_state: unit field (not a condition the engine applies by id)

items.name: Grappled
items.text: An enemy next to you is holding you. You can't move, and you have −2 to hit anyone but the one holding you. Breaking free costs 2 AP and an opposed roll, each side using the better of Raw Power and Athletics. It also ends if the holder moves away or goes down.

items.name: Taunted
items.text: Your next attack must be aimed at the one who Taunted you, if you can see them. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round, and ends early if you attack them or they go down.

items.name: Commanded
items.text: On your next turn you obey one short order, unless it would directly harm you. An enemy can be ordered to halt, hold (no attacks), drop its weapon, kneel or flee; the Sigil word COMMAND orders halt, kneel, drop your weapon or a move of up to 3 tiles.

effects.note: Pick the ordered action; refuse it if it is directly self-harmful.

items.name: Puppeted
items.text: The caster decides what you do on your next turn, using your AP. You can't be made to harm yourself. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round, and ends early if the caster goes down.

effects.note: Caster chooses the target's actions for one turn; no self-harm.

items.name: Disarmed
items.text: Your weapon is on the ground, in the pile on your tile, and you can't attack with it. Recovering it costs {=effects.1.ap} AP. Drawing another weapon into your main hand, or moving your off-hand weapon there, also ends it; the dropped weapon stays in the pile.

items.name: Injured
items.text: A wound from a critical hit; what it does depends on where it lands. Head: Dazed for 1 turn. Torso: Bleeding. Arm: −2 to attacks with that arm. Leg: half Movement. Arm and leg injuries stay until they are treated, by surgery or a long rest with a medic.

effects.note: Apply the listed penalty for the chosen location.

items.name: Emplaced
items.text: Your heavy weapon is set on a bipod, a mount or the edge of cover. You have +2 to hit with it and its Recoil is halved. It ends when you move.

items.name: Augment Offline
items.text: One of your augments, prosthetics or implants has stopped working: it gives no bonus and you can't use its actions. It stays that way until it is repaired, by a field repair or a long rest.

effects.note: Pick the affected augment; suppress its effects.

items.name: Suppressed
items.text: You have {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less on your turn and can't make attacking or moving reactions (protective ones still work). Lasts {=duration.rounds} round.

items.name: Withdrawing
items.label: Withdrawing (+2 Defense)
items.text: You are making a fighting retreat: +{=effects.0.value} Defense until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Weapon lowered
items.text: Your weapon is lowered, and until you raise it you can only strike with your fists. Raising it costs 1 AP.

items.name: Last Turn
items.text: You are standing on borrowed time, thanks to Bite the Bullet. Every hit you take adds a failed death save.

effects.note: set and run by the perk

items.name: Corroded
items.text: You take {=effects.0.value|abs} damage at the start of each of your turns and have {=effects.1.value} Defense. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds. At the end of each of your turns you roll a Body save, and a success ends it early.
ends_on: body save at the end of each of your turns (12 + the strength of whoever put it on you, by the skill that delivered it)

items.name: Quickened
items.text: You have 2 more AP on your next turn, up to the limit of 9 AP. You can be Quickened once a round at most, and never by your own spell.
ends_on: used at your next turn start

items.name: Sharpened
items.text: Your next attack has +3 to hit and deals ×{=effects.1.value} damage. It lasts until that attack or the end of your next turn.
ends_on: the end of your next turn

items.name: Smitten
items.text: You can't attack the one who Smote you, or any ally linked to them. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round. It comes from The Matchmaker's Sweet Nothings.

items.name: Hopeful
items.label: Hopeful (+2)
items.text: Your next attack or spell roll has +2. It lasts until that roll or the end of your next turn. It comes from the feeling Hope.
ends_on: the end of your next turn

items.name: Scorned
items.text: You have −2 to hit the one who Scorned you. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds. It comes from the feeling Contempt.

items.name: Guarded
items.label: Guarded (+2 Defense)
items.text: You have +{=effects.0.value} Defense. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Inspired
items.label: Inspired (+2 to hit)
items.text: You have +{=effects.0.value} to hit. Lasts {=duration.rounds} rounds.

items.name: Slipping
items.label: Slipping (no opportunity attacks)
items.text: Your move draws no opportunity attack. It ends when the move does.
items.source: Classes 3.0 step 3, Run and Gun (rules 1.30, item 1808)

items.name: Exposed
items.text: A seam in your guard is open: {=effects.0.value} Defense. Lasts {=duration.rounds} round.

items.name: Off Balance
items.text: Caught at the wrong moment: you have {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less on your next turn.
ends_on: used at your next turn start

families.body: Physical conditions. You resist them with a Body save.
families.brain: Mental conditions. You resist them with a Brain save.
families.heart: Emotional conditions. You resist them with a Heart save.

family_ref: An effect may name 'family:<body|brain|heart>' instead of a single condition id; it means any condition of that family.
engine_ref: How the engine runs each condition (packages/engine/src/condtable.ts reads this file; there is no other table). engine 'table': kept in a unit's conditions with its rounds left, put on by applyCond and ended by endCond. 'flag': a field of the unit (Bleeding, Dazed, Prone, Hidden, Injured), written only by applyCond and endCond. 'state': a unit state with its own rule and its own setter (Braced, Overwatch, Downed); applyCond does not put it on. duration: {rounds: N} counts the ends of the bearer's own turns; {until: <word>} lasts until its rule ends it. save: true means the target rolls its family's save unless the source says there is none. boon: true is a help, never saved against, and no family. key: the name it is stored under in a unit's conditions when that is not the id; aliases: other ids the engine answers to; label: the word in 'X is <label>' when it is not the name. The numbers the engine applies are read from effects: stat_mod defense, move_mult, vision, ap, save_<family>, damage_dealt_pct, sigil_ap, soul_cost_pct; skill_mod_tag; attack_mod by context (own_attacks, next_attack, not_vs_source, vs_source, marker_squad_vs_self, melee_vs_self, ranged_vs_self); damage_mult next_attack.
